title: Health Event Coalescing

evidence.claim: RecoveryEventLedger.observe_health atomically coalesces repeated identical health observations while preserving healthy transitions and materially changed state.
UnifiedHealthInspector now records component health through state-aware coalescing instead of unconditional append for every non-healthy inspection.
Unit coverage verifies duplicate suppression, silent initial healthy state, healthy-transition markers, recurrence visibility, and changed-detail preservation.
Inspector integration coverage verifies repeated startup-style inspections do not grow the ledger and that recovered then recurring faults remain auditable.

remaining_backlog: Source Registry and Signal Store default startup health wiring
blockers: Current branch-head CI result is pending.
next_action: Add multiprocess end-to-end crash/recovery tests across transaction journal, review queue, recovery ledger, and startup health gate.
